data_objects.name: forest_tree_measurements
data_objects.meaning: Measurements and species attributes for individual trees grouped into forest plots.
data_objects.notes: Tree-level measurements are associated with a plot identifier and paired species code and scientific name.

variables.name: LIVE_ID
variables.meaning: Identifier for the individual live-tree record.

variables.name: PLTID
variables.meaning: Identifier of the forest plot containing or representing the tree.

variables.name: SPP_SYMBOL
variables.meaning: Abbreviated species code associated with the tree.

variables.name: SCIENTIFIC_NAME
variables.meaning: Scientific taxon name corresponding to the species code.

variables.name: CON
variables.meaning: Binary indicator named CON, encoded as 0 or 1; its underlying condition is not defined by the evidence.

variables.name: TPH_PLT
variables.meaning: Plot-associated trees-per-hectare value carried on the tree record.

structure.description: Each row represents an individual tree measurement; LIVE_ID serves as the record identifier and PLTID groups multiple trees by plot.
SPP_SYMBOL and SCIENTIFIC_NAME provide coded and human-readable representations of species identity.
CON is a binary 0/1 encoding, while DBH_CM, HT_M, BA_M2, and TPH_PLT carry units in their source names.

uncertainties: The expansion or sampling interpretation of TPH_PLT is not stated.
The meaning of the CON indicator and the taxonomic treatment of combined scientific names are not defined.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv table was used as evidence.
